other_failure_modes.name: Unstable target mapping
other_failure_modes.description: Using `pd.factorize` on the target column as a fallback assigns integer labels based purely on the order of appearance. In binary classification, this can arbitrarily flip the positive and negative classes depending on data shuffling, leading to inverted predictions and meaningless metric interpretations.

summary: The agent implements a generally sound LightGBM pipeline with robust categorical handling and sensible financial feature engineering. However, it critically fails to account for the temporal nature of Lending Club data by using a randomized CV split (introducing look-ahead bias). Furthermore, its fallback target mapping relies on an unstable factorization method which can arbitrarily invert the classification labels.
